name: announce-title
title: Announce Title
description: A four-shot launch title: the eyebrow rushes past the camera on a receding type plane and lands on a colour field, the name assembles word by word on paper, and a macro pan across the tagline cuts wide as the line builds itself last word first while a white sweep drains it out of colour. Content, palette and the mark that leads the closing line are all props.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/announce-title?ref=cli — its colours are explicit props (`paperColor`, `titleColor`, `voidColor`, …) rather than a palette, and it takes no `mode`.
